outfit.name: 维多利亚近卫军校学员礼服
outfit.prose: a Victorian Royal Guard Military Academy cadet dress uniform: a deep navy double-breasted military jacket with gold braided trim, brass buttons and tasseled gold epaulettes over a crisp white high-collar shirt with a dark red neck scarf, beige high-waisted equestrian jodhpurs, polished black knee-high riding boots, white cavalry gloves and a fencing rapier at her belt
